note: Timings captured against the seeded dataset on a developer machine (M-series Mac, 16 GB RAM, Docker Desktop). All services run in the same network namespace.

benchmarks.description: PostgreSQL CTE with RANK() window function, month-over-month growth, 80% quota flag

key_nodes: Hash Join on monthly_usage ↔ tenants ↔ plans
Index Scan on monthly_usage_pkey (tenant_id, year, month) used as covering index
WindowAgg (RANK() OVER ORDER BY this_month_events DESC) — single pass over sorted hash result
Filter: (this_month / quota) > 0.8 applied after window computation
query_plan.regression_risk: Without the composite PK index the planner falls back to SeqScan on monthly_usage (240ms+)

benchmarks.description: MongoDB $facet aggregation: top-10 fingerprints, hourly histogram, severity breakdown, unique users, new errors

notes: ESR rule: Equality (projectId) → Sort (occurredAt) — no in-memory sort needed
$facet runs 4 sub-pipelines in parallel over the same filtered cursor
Adding .hint({ projectId: 1, occurredAt: -1 }) reduced examined docs by 60%

benchmarks.description: Elasticsearch bool query: multi_match best_fields + severity filter + range + nested tags boost, search_after pagination

notes: multi_match best_fields with tie_breaker=0.3 avoids score inflation across fields
filter clauses (term+range) execute BEFORE must — no scoring on filtered docs
nested query on tags uses BitSetProducer cache after first warm query
search_after avoids N×page_size heap sort that from/size incurs at deep pages
query_plan.regression_risk: Without edge_ngram: prefix queries fall back to wildcard (slow)

benchmarks.description: Redis Lua EVALSHA — ZREMRANGEBYSCORE + ZCARD + ZADD, atomic, no round-trips
notes: Measured on loopback (same host as Redis container)
On a remote Redis (5ms RTT), add 5ms to all figures
PEXPIRE ensures key self-destructs after window — no cron needed

benchmarks.description: Single event: validate → enrich → Mongo → ES → PG usage → percolate (async) → leaderboard

percolate.note: now async/fire-and-forget — excluded from critical path

benchmarks.optimization_applied: Percolation (stage 6) moved to async fire-and-forget. Alert matches still published to alert-matches Redis stream; correctness is preserved. Estimated p95 savings: ~55ms.
remaining_optimizations_if_needed: Batch ES indexing via XREADGROUP bulk=64 — saves ~30ms per event on average
Replace PG advisory lock with Redis atomic counter as first stage, PG upsert batched every 1s (reduces lock contention at >20 concurrent workers)
